verdict.rationale: Solo 2 exposes programmatic surfaces: a CLI (solo2 list/update/app admin) and standard protocols (FIDO2/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP). So API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
